notes: Amber dusk is gone — from the theme wall and from the widget shelf. Nothing else changed shape: a phone that was wearing it settles on Coral, and a widget that was on it settles on Bubblegum, on the next launch.

Lagoon sits at the bottom of the dynamic themes, where it belongs and where it is declared. It was being lifted to the top of that group by its “new” flag; the flag is gone, so it closes the group again.

Liquid pastel is the new widget preset: rose and lilac as the two stops, a mint accent, and it is a glass preset — the same translucent pane as Liquid glass, in the colour of the preview strip. The Frost dial tunes it too, so the pane goes from thin to thick on either one.

The widget now has layouts for the size you give it. Drag it into a 4×1 and it becomes one row: cover, title, transport. 4×2 and 2×4 get a roomier arrangement — and the ones with room draw a progress bar with the two clock readings, fed by the player as it plays. Resizing repaints on the spot, no re-adding.
The player, the library, the lyrics and the audio graph are untouched.
